question: A rigid electric dipole (moment p) is free to rotate about its center in a uniform electric field E. Considering the orientations θ = 0° (parallel), θ = 90° (perpendicular), and θ = 180° (anti-parallel), identify the torque magnitude and stability at these positions.

options.A: Torque is maximum at 90°; 0° is a stable equilibrium; 180° is an unstable equilibrium.
options.B: Torque is maximum at 0°; both 0° and 180° are stable equilibria.
options.C: Torque is maximum at 180°; 0° is unstable; 90° is stable.
options.D: Torque is zero at 90°; 0° is unstable; 180° is stable.
